# Off Leash K9 Of Northern Virginia

> Professional dog training in Northern Virginia specializing in off-leash obedience, board and train programs, and behavioral correction using e-collar and positive reinforcement methods.

K9 NoVA offers comprehensive dog training services across Northern Virginia including Woodbridge, Alexandria, and Arlington. Led by trainers Dean and Mandy, the facility provides everything from puppy training to aggression rehabilitation through both in-person and virtual formats.

## Key Topics

- Off-leash training
- Board and train programs
- E-collar training
- Obedience training
- Puppy training
- Aggressive dog training
- Dog reactivity
- Positive reinforcement
- Clicker training
- Therapy dog certification
- Virtual lessons
- Northern Virginia
- Dean & Mandy trainers
- Behavioral correction
- Private lessons

## Core Programs & Services

- [Board & Train Dog Training In NoVA](https://offleashk9nova.com/board-train-dog-training): Overview of K9 NoVA's board and train programs for obedience and behavior correction
- [ExpeditePro™ (1 Week)](https://offleashk9nova.com/product/1-week-board-train-expeditepro): 1-week expedited board and train program with e-collar training
- [ExpeditePro™ (3 Week)](https://offleashk9nova.com/product/3-week-board-train-expeditepro): 3-week expedited board and train program with equipment
- [1 Week Freedom Board & Train](https://offleashk9nova.com/product/1-week-board-train-freedom-program): 1-week off-leash freedom program for park and beach access
- [2 Week Board & Train – Urban K9](https://offleashk9nova.com/product/2-week-board-train-urban-k9): 2-week urban training program for high-distraction metropolitan environments
- [2 Week Board & Train – Community K9](https://offleashk9nova.com/product/2-week-board-train-community-k9): 2-week mid-level distraction board and train program for real-world behavior
- [3 Week Reactivity Board & Train](https://offleashk9nova.com/product/3-week-board-train-reactivity-program): 3-week on-leash reactivity program for anxious dogs

## Obedience & Behavioral Training

- [Basic & Advanced Obedience](https://offleashk9nova.com/product/basic-advanced-obedience): 8 private obedience lessons with e-collar training by K9 NoVA experts
- [Basic Obedience](https://offleashk9nova.com/product/basic-obedience): Private lessons teaching essential commands using e-collars and leashes
- [Aggressive Dog Training](https://offleashk9nova.com/product/aggressive-dog-training): 8-week aggression and reactivity training program with desensitization
- [Therapy Dog Preparation](https://offleashk9nova.com/product/therapy-dog-preparation): 8-week therapy dog certification prep program by K9 NoVA trainers

## Puppy & Alternative Training

- [Basic Marker Mastery™](https://offleashk9nova.com/product/basic-marker-mastery): 4-week positive reinforcement puppy program using clicker training
- [Virtual Lesson](https://offleashk9nova.com/product/virtual-lesson): One-hour personalized Zoom training sessions with K9 NoVA experts Dean and Mandy
- [Course – Raising the Perfect Dog](https://offleashk9nova.com/course): Free course by Joey Zitzelberger for K9 NoVA clients
